steps.label: Engage
steps.sub: captures the request and the real need behind it

steps.label: Plan
steps.sub: weighs it against everything else competing for priority

steps.label: Design & transition
steps.sub: specifies, tests, and plans the rollout

steps.label: Obtain/build
steps.sub: sources the license or integration the spec calls for

steps.label: Deliver & support
steps.sub: runs it live, handles what self-service can't resolve

code:
Engage:               notices a repeating request pattern
Plan:                 notices its own process is slow
Design & transition:  notices a repeat defect
Deliver & support:    notices the live tool needs a fix
caption: Not a seventh step — active inside all five others.

eyebrow: Value stream: size depends on the scenario
code:
Building the capability:
  touches all six activities — large stream

Using it, once built:
  mostly Engage + Deliver & support — small stream
caption: Same six activities every time; different weight each time.

eyebrow: Placing a scenario on the chain
code:
Capturing a need        -> Engage
Deciding priority       -> Plan
Specifying a change     -> Design & transition
Sourcing a component    -> Obtain/build
Running day to day      -> Deliver & support
Feeding back a fix      -> Improve
caption: The skill the exam and real work both test.

subtitle: Where most of ITIL 4's day-to-day work happens.
